### 2026-10-18 – # progress update for two days (17 & 18 oct)

**11.5h**

# progress update for two days (17 & 18 oct)

##  Learning update:
alright making this project was a bast . sometimes i was happy & listening to music and sometimes crying . it took a lot of effort and time . so tomorrow   for 2 hours & today for 2 hours i took few tutorials i did learn about a lot of thing that includes & may not be limited to : Revolve, Fillet, Helix, Sweep, reference planes, scaling,extrude ,thicken,spline , coincident , dimensions ,  3 point arc , apperance panel etc .

## making of Lucille
it was a challenge as this was my first time working on a cad project . i was really nervous throughout the day.
i started making it with not a lot of clue . i used a reference image made an outline and worked on to make a bat but i was not able to make for quite a few time . after that i use helix and other appropriate tolls to make barbed wire. but to my surprise i realised that it all was a surface not an solid . i did not know any way to make it solid i tried  and totaled the cad design . so i had to start over and make it again when this problem happend again i had to do a lot of research . i tried youtube , public forums but i found a solution on reddit . and made it a solid . the i had to slice it in to two parts . also i had to scale it. i also had to make sure it has no gaps and is a enclosed shape . after that i exported files in STL and STP format

#how i feel about this
over all i feel that i truly have learned something and was able to use that learnings to make something real
